tasks.title: Solar-term engine
tasks.description: lib/bazi.ts: sun apparent-longitude (Meeus low-precision) + a root-finder for solar-term instants. Verify Li Chun ~Feb 4 and the equinoxes/solstices land on the right dates across a spread of years.

tasks.title: Four pillars + Day Master
tasks.description: Year pillar (Li Chun boundary), month pillar (solar term + Five Tigers stem rule), day pillar (JDN mod 60 anchor), hour pillar (Five Rats rule + double-hour, optional local-solar-time). Day Master = day stem. Data tables for 10 stems + 12 branches (element, polarity, animal, main-qi hidden stem).

tasks.title: Ten Gods + element balance + time-unknown
tasks.description: Label the 7 non-day-master characters via element relation + polarity vs the Day Master. Count the five elements across the chart. Support time-unknown (6 characters, skip hour pillar).

tasks.title: Reference-chart verification
tasks.description: Cross-check the engine against ~10 authoritative reference charts (spanning pre/post Li Chun, month boundaries, near-midnight, time-unknown). Calibrate the day anchor. Ship only when it matches.
